# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The trendline break signal (detected via market_structure.py) occurs prior to losing call entries on J's loser days (specifically 5/07), allowing a call-veto to block these losing trades without affecting the put winners. This structure-based veto isolates the call side to avoid counter-trend call losses while preserving the profitable put-side entries.

## Mechanism

When the `call_veto_enabled` parameter is set to true, the engine checks for a bearish trendline break signal (as defined by the trendline_break structure signal) before allowing any call entry. If a bearish trendline break is detected, the call entry is vetoed. Put entries are unaffected by this veto, as the signal is not used as a put gate (it fires equally on all J dates for puts). The veto is applied in the entry path after signal derivation and before order placement.
